name: Miner's Fortune
summary: Wharfmaster Dizzywig has word of a great emerald at Boulder Lode Mine. He wants you to take it from the Venture Company's overseers and share the proceeds.

sections.title: Eyes on the Docks
sections.body: Merchants sailing between Ratchet and Booty Bay bring news to Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Now word has reached him of a huge gem found deep in Boulder Lode Mine. The Venture Company strips the northern Barrens for its own gain, so few are likely to ask questions if its finest recent find vanishes.

sections.title: A Cut of the Lode
sections.body: Northeast of the Sludge Fen, laborers work the rocky shaft of Boulder Lode Mine. The Venture Co. Overseers and Enforcers hold the Cats Eye Emerald, and an ordinary digger cannot claim so rare a prize. Face the armed managers, take the stone, and bring it to Dizzywig. He can weigh its worth against the market in Undermine.

faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig is a goblin dock official in Ratchet. He oversees cargo and passengers sailing to and from Booty Bay, and trades in gossip, rumors, and merchant news.

faq.q: Where is the Boulder Lode Mine located?
faq.answer: Boulder Lode Mine lies in the northern Barrens, in the hills just northeast of the Sludge Fen's oil operation.

faq.q: Who holds the Cats Eye Emerald at the mine?
faq.answer: The Venture Co. Overseers and Venture Co. Enforcers hold the Cats Eye Emerald. They direct and guard the mining work at Boulder Lode Mine.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company's interest in the Barrens?
aliases: why is venture co in barrens
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a goblin trade syndicate that rapidly exploits resources. In the northern Barrens, it drills at the Sludge Fen and digs at Boulder Lode Mine for timber, oil, and minerals, with little regard for local ecology.
Undermine is the goblin cartels' underground island city and ancestral capital. Its markets set prices for precious gems and rare goods across Azeroth.

faq.q: Does Dizzywig actually share the profits?
faq.answer: Dizzywig promises you half the estimated Undermine market value when you deliver the Cats Eye Emerald. He honors the bargain.

angles.text: As a miner, you know how rare a whole emerald the size of a fist must be. Gems that large almost never survive excavation without cracking or breaking.
As a rogue, you know how to slip into a hostile camp and take a guarded gemstone from greedy overseers.
As a member of the Horde, you strike at the Venture Company's managers at Boulder Lode Mine. You disrupt an industrial cartel encroaching on Horde-held Barrens lands.
